rdfs:label: Relationship
rdfs:comment: An ActivityStreams Object representing a typed relationship between two other Objects — typically two actors (Person, Application, Group, Organization or Service) connected by a relationship type (friend, colleague, follower).
notes: Carries `as:subject`, `as:object`, and `as:relationship` (the kind of link). Reify a connection as a first-class entity when you need to attach metadata to it (when it started, who asserted it, whether it's reciprocated) — otherwise a direct property like `urn:solid:knows` (foaf:knows) is simpler. Note `urn:solid:subject` is dcterms:subject, not as:subject — use the full AS IRI.

examples.title: A reified friendship between two actors

history.note: Dropped nonexistent Actor and relationship aliases; as:subject/as:relationship now full AS IRIs (urn:solid:subject is dcterms:subject); notes point at urn:solid:knows.
